name: copilot-rtl
description: Adds Right-to-Left (RTL) support and Vazirmatn font styling to the GitHub Copilot Chat panel, for Persian/Farsi, Arabic, Hebrew and other RTL languages.
author: NabiKAZ

commands.title: Copilot RTL: Re-apply Patch (after a VS Code update)
Copilot RTL: Open Menu (direction, font, size…)

copilotRtl.autoEnable.description: Automatically (re)apply the RTL patch to VS Code's workbench on startup.

enumDescriptions: Force right-to-left direction in the chat area
Force left-to-right direction in the chat area
copilotRtl.direction.description: Text direction forced on the Copilot Chat area (applies live, no reload needed). The prompt input box always auto-detects direction per line, regardless of this setting.

copilotRtl.fontFamily.description: Font family used in the Copilot Chat area (applies live, no reload needed). If the font isn't installed, this falls back to Vazirmatn (using the copy bundled with the extension if Vazirmatn isn't installed either).

copilotRtl.fontSize.description: Font size (in pixels) used in the Copilot Chat area (applies live, no reload needed).

copilotRtl.lineHeight.description: Line height (spacing between lines) used in the Copilot Chat area (applies live, no reload needed).
